description: Fill AcroForm form fields in a PDF and save or return the result. Field names must exist in the PDF (use pdf_inspect first). All values are strings; checkboxes take "true"/"false"; dropdown/radio/optionlist values must be one of the field's options; text values must respect the field's maxLength from pdf_inspect. The source PDF is never modified. Returns the filled PDF written to output_path, or inline as an application/pdf resource when output_path is omitted; an existing file at output_path is overwritten. Owner-locked PDFs (empty user password, common for government blanks) fill without a password; a user-password PDF needs the password parameter, otherwise it is rejected with encrypted_pdf. A rejected fill writes no file at all.

fields.description: Field name → string value (from pdf_inspect's fillTemplate)

flatten.description: Bake values into page content and drop the AcroForm so fields are no longer editable

output_path.description: Path of a .pdf file to write the result to, inside the allowed directories (PDFOPS_ROOT, default the working directory); an existing file there is overwritten. Omit when running remotely: the PDF is then returned inline as an application/pdf resource for the client to save.

password.description: Password to open the input, only needed for a user-password PDF (owner-locked files with an empty user password open without it).

pdf_path.description: Template PDF source: a path to a .pdf file inside the allowed directories (PDFOPS_ROOT, default the working directory), an https:// URL, or a data:application/pdf;base64,… URI. Use a URL or data URI when this server runs remotely (Smithery, hosted gateways) where local paths do not exist.

name: pdf_fill

bytes.description: Size of the produced PDF in bytes

output_path.description: Absolute path written, when output_path was supplied

resource_uri.description: pdfops:// uri of the inline application/pdf resource, when output_path was omitted

title: Fill PDF form
